messages:
maya (EngPlatform): trying to sketch an inbound acceptance playbook for metering events. goal: avoid big backfills and keep attribution sane when late/duplicate events land. thoughts?
joel (SRE): +1. do minimal validation on ingest, tag as provisional, then finalize in downstream reconcile. we had trouble rejecting at edge — ops ended up replaying a lot. :grimacing:
sam (DataEng): what by minimal validation? fingerprint present, tenant id, event type, and a monotonic offset probably. anything heavier (eg full provenance) becomes slow.
maya (EngPlatform): exactly. proposal: 1) accept if fingerprint && tenant && model_id 2) dedupe using short-term cache 3) mark provisional and write to kafka topic partitioned by tenant 4) downstream finalizer verifies complete provenance and emits credits.
anya (Billing): provisional credits are tricky for finance. we need deterministic finalization and an audit trail showing the provisional -> final mapping. otherwise invoices are messy. can we attach a finalization id and keep both rows?
sam (DataEng): yep attach finalization_id = null initially, finalizer writes finalization_id and moves to canonical topic. we can keep provisional index for 7 days then GC after finalization or manual review.
maya (EngPlatform): quick sketch of edge rules: ```
# ingest validator pseudo
if not fingerprint: reject 400
if duplicate_in_5min_cache(fingerprint): ack_no_write
write({payload, provisional:true, ingestion_ts:now})
```
joel (SRE): what about late-arrival rewrites (customer resends corrected attribution)? we need an ownership policy: either allow overwrite within window W or create a correction event that finalizer consumes and adjusts ledgers.
anya (Billing): prefer correction events. overwrites are hard to audit. correction events produce delta rows and are easy to reason about in billing.
devon (Product): for customers, we should expose a state: pending -> reconciled -> corrected. console needs a simple UX and webhooks for pending->finalized state changes. can the finalizer emit a webhook?
sam (DataEng): yes finalizer emits events: finalization/success or finalization/correction. those go to the notification bus.
maya (EngPlatform): tradeoffs: earlier strong validation reduces downstream noise but increases edge rejects and support tickets. lighter ingest increases downstream complexity but we keep throughput and lower latency ingests. ops preference?
joel (SRE): ops likes ingest light + fast. recovering from bad downstream logic is easier than fixing an overloaded edge. also better for autoscaling.
anya (Billing): but finance SLA: finalization must complete within 24h for most customers. we need monitoring/alerts on finalizer lag and failed finalizations. add a playbook: if finalizer lag > 30m escalate to oncall and start a priority backfill.
maya (EngPlatform): noted. propose implementing: - 5min dedupe cache - provisional TTL 7d - finalization window 24h SLA with 30m warn - correction event model instead of overwrite - audit frame linking provisional -> finalization_id - webhook + console states
sre-bot: detected deployment tag for metering-finalizer:v2 on staging at sha abc123. automated smoke will run and post results.
sam (DataEng): one more nit: shard routing. partition by tenant_id helps isolation but can cause hotspots for large tenants. plan: tenant-hash with overflow routing to dedicated partitions for known heavy tenants.
maya (EngPlatform): agree. include tenant routing config and allow pinning heavy tenants to dedicated streams (Dedicated capacity teams will like that).
devon (Product): ok if we have finalization_id and correction events we can show line-item level provenance in invoices. that will unblock a lot of customers.
anya (Billing): and keep an append-only audit topic for all transitions (ingest->provisional->finalize->correction). requires retention >= 90 days for audits.
joel (SRE): also add a reconciliation job that runs daily to detect mismatches between final ledger and invoice numbers and emits tickets automatically.
maya (EngPlatform): thanks all. i'll write up an RFC follow-up with these concrete knobs and a minimal acceptance checklist for staging: dedupe cache enabled, provisional flag, finalizer smoke passing, webhook receiver stub. anyone want to pair on the RFC tomorrow?
sam (DataEng): I'll pair.
anya (Billing): can join for the parts about finalization semantics.
devon (Product): happy to review UX bits.
joel (SRE): will add failure-mode runbooks.
maya (EngPlatform): sweet. pinging @here when RFC draft is up. :rocket:
